_meta.description: Same rollout, but promo stores were already growing 1.2 units/week faster and the promotion did nothing (true effect 0). Naive DiD reports ~+15; the pre-trend test (slope gap 1.25, p ≈ 0) and drifting event-study gaps show parallel trends fail.

estimate_note: Not graded: with clearly diverging pre-trends no DiD estimate is trustworthy; the right answer is the verdict and the pre-trend finding.
